items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Cootie Williams' small band.

ctx.x: And Cootie sent him the fare and he didn't come and -- so when you met him, he must have found his feet by then.
Well, yes, he'd been playing with Cootie.
Yeah, he was -- got himself at home.

items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I saw you had him working for you at one time. You like him as a drummer? ... Yeah. Gus Johnson's a very fine drummer.

ctx.x: because I saw you had him working for you at one time. You like him as a drummer?

Yeah. Gus Johnson's a very fine drummer. According to what type you wanted him for. Gus Johnson is drumming now for singers in small groups. It's a different feeling with small groups and singers, and you fitting in with a big band.
With a big band, yeah. But he -- I mean he was a heavy enough drummer to fit in with a band. Well, that's how he started off, as a band drummer, didn't he?
